name: Tokimeki Memorial 2 Substories: Memories Ringing On
summary: A follow-up to Tokimeki Memorial 2, Memories Ringing On is set one year after graduation, with the protagonist remembering his school days at a coffee shop. He mostly focuses on his last Valentine's Day in high school, and how several girls acted that one day.
